pages.title: SMS-1 "Hyperion"
pages.text: ORSA's superconducting storage silo. It holds hundreds of times what a Battery Bank does, as long as it stays cold.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: Three parts do the work.$(li)Superconducting Cells hold the charge$(li)A Cryocooler keeps them below -180C$(li)Ports move power in and out$(li)Each cell holds 20 MJ

pages.title: Before You Build
pages.text: $(danger)Breaking any part while it holds charge quenches it at once.$() The charge is lost, but nothing is damaged. An empty silo is safe to build, change and take down.
